about_the_game:
In this game you will run a colony of fairies. Your relationships with your human neighbors are complicated. From one hand, you rely on their resources (mainly their dreams) to grow. From the other hand, their expansion will eventually overrun you.

To survive, you will need to collect enough resources to eventually open a portal and escape.



Gameplay

The game is a turn based game focused on managing land and resources.

You have the means to slow down the human expansion, but you have to keep a balance. Hinder them too much will halt your own development. Letting them lose will cause them to grow exponentially and overrun you.

Overtime, you will be able to collect special cards to help you build your permanent palace.


CardsWhen the humans will complete the build of certain structures, you will gain cards. Those cards will provide more resources and let you research more options. Unused cards in your deck are carried between levels.



Current State of DevelopmentA demo showing the basic gameplay is available and I'm constantly working on improving both it and the final game including better UI, music and more.

content_descriptors.notes: While the game itself is not about adult themes, it is hinted in some of the flavor text like. This includes hints for horror, erotica and alcohol consumption.
